jobs.title: PhD in Civil Engineering
jobs.summary: PhD in Civil Engineering in the Lyles School of Civil and Construction Engineering; there is no separate funding application, and only highly competitive PhD students recommended for admission are typically offered funding (about 25%), decided by faculty with available positions. Review for August admission begins 1 December, and application materials are accepted until 15 May for fall consideration.

jobs.title: PhD in Civil Engineering
